name: Junk Seeker
source:
Natsuki lives with Kurumi, his younger sister. He earns money by fighting against monsters every day. One day, he meets Shizuka. She asks him to look for her missing father. According to her, he went missing at a laboratory. Yes, the place is now a nest of the monsters...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
夏树与妹妹胡桃共同生活。他每天靠与怪物战斗赚钱。一天，他遇见静香。她请夏树寻找失踪的父亲。据她所说，父亲在一座研究所中失踪。没错，那里如今已经成了怪物巢穴…

[From ErogeShop]
